verification_level: FAST plus BATCH; no STOP (no UB, ABI regression or hidden obligation); no defect in the eight audited files, three authority-UB/overflow guards applied to the queued CBC-HMAC-SHA1 follow-up
scope: Per-file audit of eight ordinary EVP units: the SM4 and DESX legacy cipher statics, the alg_section configuration handler, the two X509_ALGOR hand-offs, and the BLAKE2b/BLAKE2s, MD4 and MD5 legacy digest statics. keymgmt_lib.rs was skipped as a provider export/import dispatch boundary and legacy_md5.rs was substituted from the next stable queue slot. The queued M54 follow-up (negative/undersized/overflowing legacy controls in e_aes_cbc_hmac_sha1.rs) was repaired with two runtime controls.

files_not_run.reason: Provider export/import dispatch boundary: operation cache keyed on (name_id, prov), read/write lock protocol, provider callbacks. Deferred for a dedicated boundary audit; it remains in REMAINING-AUDIT.txt and is the first file of the next queue.

defects.description: EVP_CTRL_AEAD_SET_MAC_KEY with a negative arg reached the provider's size_t length and then a huge read from the caller's pointer. A negative key length is never valid; the authority makes the same int-to-size_t conversion and faults.
defects.fix: Refuse arg < 0 with -1 before any pointer use (§17).
defects.witness: Code and compile review; no in-tree fixture constructs a legacy CBC-HMAC-SHA1 context for this private control (NOT_RUN for a runtime control).

defects.description: The legacy MULTIBLOCK_ENCRYPT arm dereferenced the parameter block without the size test its _AAD sibling makes, so a short arg produced an out-of-bounds parameter read.
defects.fix: Refuse arg < size_of::<EvpCtrlTls11MultiblockParam>() with -1, matching the provider arm's recorded deliberate divergence.
defects.witness: Code and compile review; no in-tree fixture constructs the legacy context (NOT_RUN for a runtime control).

defects.class: signed overflow in a size answer
defects.description: EVP_CTRL_TLS1_1_MULTIBLOCK_MAX_BUFSIZE computed arg + 20 + 16 in c_int. The SHA-1 digest constant (20) is correct, but a fragment size near INT_MAX overflows: debug panics and release wraps. The authority's signed addition is undefined there.
defects.fix: Extract tls11_multiblock_max_bufsize(arg) with checked_add/checked padding and an overflow refusal of -1.

contracts_reused: Legacy EVP_CIPHER callback contract: init/do_cipher/ctrl callers supply a live EVP_CIPHER_CTX whose cipher_data block has at least the cipher's ctx_size (cipher_ctx.rs, RC-1-adjacent)
OB-3/OB-4 shared owned-context release: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_reset and the init-failure paths cleanse cipher_data (OPENSSL_cleanse or CRYPTO_clear_free) before release
Legacy EVP_MD static contract: EVP_ORIG_GLOBAL objects are refused by up_ref/free; ctx_size 0 is safe because the provider fetch replaces the method before any callback reads md_data
OB-1 OwnedBuf: evp_lib.rs's aid block is owned at the authority's exact OPENSSL_malloc/OPENSSL_free file and line, with a single Drop release
NCONF section contract: NCONF_get_section answers a stack whose elements are live CONF_VALUE entries with NUL-terminated names
Authority differential contract for the legacy static initialisers: NID, pkey NID, size, block size, flags, origin, ASN.1 views and ctx_size field for field
residuals: The legacy ctrl callbacks of e_aes_cbc_hmac_sha1.rs remain reachable only through an engine; no in-tree fixture constructs such a context, so M55-D1/D2 have no runtime witness.

The digest statics in legacy_blake2.rs, legacy_md4.rs and legacy_md5.rs are carriers only: they own no md_data and cannot be armed through the normal EVP_DigestInit_ex path because the provider fetch either succeeds or refuses.
keymgmt_lib.rs is not audited in this receipt; its operation cache and provider round trip retain their existing obligations and remain queued.
No constant-time claim is made for any unit in this batch.
